extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: MACS J0416.1-2403 (z=0.396). Caminha, Grillo, Rosati, Balestra, Mercurio, Vanzella et al. 2017, A&A 600, A90, table 'catalog' = 'Full redshift catalog, combining the MUSE and VIMOS measurements'. 4594 redshifts - the largest MACS0416 catalogue in this product, and a superset of Balestra+2016. Quality: column q_z, values 2-9 (CLASH-VLT convention: 2=likely, 3=secure, 4=highly secure, 9=single emission line). Column r_z (1-6) gives the provenance of each redshift. Instrument: VLT/VIMOS (CLASH-VLT large programme) combined with VLT/MUSE for the core. Selection function: CLASH-VLT VIMOS targets are photometrically preselected from Subaru/Suprime-Cam imaging with a Kron R-band limit around R<24 plus colour-colour preselection designed to enhance the yield of cluster members and lensed background sources - this is a COLOUR-PRESELECTED sample, so the radial selection function is not uniform and completeness varies with radius and galaxy colour. Rmag column (ESO-WFI 2.2m Kron R, AB) is provided. Sky coverage: to ~17.4 arcmin (~5.5 Mpc projected); 90% within ~4.2 Mpc - genuinely wide-field, so a resolved sigma(R) is feasible for this cluster.
